design_issues.screen: Landing mobile (390px) — How it works & What's inside carousels
issues: Cards render much wider than spec: measured getBoundingClientRect().width = 761px for how-step-01 and 735px for feature-0 at 390px viewport (~195% of viewport width). Spec says cards should be ~82% of viewport (~320px) so users see one full card + a peek of next. Currently only ~50% of a card is visible before scrolling. Carousel is functionally correct (horizontal scroll works, dots update, no page overflow), but visual peek/snap is off. Likely min-w-[82%] resolving against a wider intrinsic base — check aspect-[16/10] image tile + shrink-0 combination on mobile.

rca of the issue: Mobile carousel card width bug (design_issue): parent flex container width=390px, but children with min-w-[82%] measure at 761px width. Likely because aspect-[16/10] on the inner image tile + shrink-0 pushes intrinsic (max-content) card width above the 82% minimum. Suggest adding max-w to card (e.g. max-w-[82%]) OR explicit basis-[82%] with shrink-0. Verified: parent scrollWidth=2546px = 3×~761 + gaps (confirms all 3 cards oversized, not just first). Same pattern on whats-inside (feature-0 = 735px).
